goal: Lock the smallest production resume/package standard earned by live Spy Pond and Teradyne applications: DOCX-first editable/default application artifact with employer-format override; preserve the approved one-page U.S. visual/ATS standard and 92% utilization floor; require an explicit JD/requirement-to-approved-evidence package crosswalk using existing Match Truth states; and require ATS-simple DOCX structure, rendered visual QA, and exact submitted-artifact traceability without redesigning Candidate Truth, qualification, schemas, or runtime generation.
acceptance_conditions: BLUEPRINT version and project_state latest_locked_section/version remain mechanically consistent
DOCX is the canonical editable/default resume artifact when accepted by the employer/application system; explicit employer/application format instructions override
PDF remains a supported export/QA representation when required or useful, but is no longer the universal default submitted artifact
the approved one-page U.S. Letter, one-column, centered-header, restrained ATS-safe visual standard remains unchanged
the existing 92% meaningful page-utilization floor remains unchanged and may never authorize filler, unreadable type, crushed margins, or unsupported content
every serious-role resume/package uses a requirement/JD-to-evidence crosswalk derived from existing Requirement/EvidenceMatch truth rather than a new matching schema

crosswalk semantics preserve existing STRONG/SUPPORTED/PARTIAL/NONE/UNKNOWN states: positive states may guide supported emphasis; PARTIAL must retain transfer boundaries; NONE remains a gap; UNKNOWN remains unresolved

the crosswalk may drive summary emphasis, bullet selection/order, skills ordering, project selection, truthful lexical alignment, and evidence budget only; it may never repair Qualification Truth or invent unsupported capabilities

ATS-simple DOCX guidance prohibits graphics, sidebars, icons, text boxes, skill bars, multi-column layouts, and other structures likely to harm parsing/read order; simple paragraphs/tab stops are preferred for alignment
human-readable hyperlinks remain functional where relevant and the document must be rendered/visually inspected before submission
the exact submitted resume artifact/version remains traceable as Application/Package Truth
no fake ATS percentage, generic keyword stuffing, new Candidate Truth, new schema, or runtime generator is introduced by this milestone
